text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Valued added tax has realised about 16 billion naira in the first seven months of 1996, Inland Revenue Service says.
- About 23.8 billion naira is expected to be generated annually from the Ikot Abasi aluminium smelter, after it comes on stream later this year.
- About 50 quoted companies have flouted Nigerian Stock Exchange directives on timely submission of financial reports.
- A new board of directors will be elected for Savannah Bank on Tuesday after the bank's performance was turned around by by a transitional board.
- Insurers may raise premiums for Nigerian airlines next year, after a growing number of air crashes.
- PZ Industries may merge with Thermocool Engineering Company, one of its corporate partners.
- Nigeria's National Electric Power Authority signs agreements with generating companies in Benin and Togo to supply them with electricity.
